name: Em
purpose: Apply native stress emphasis while preserving the surrounding Brick typography and foreground.
useWhen: Words in a sentence need semantic stress emphasis that changes the meaning or cadence when spoken.

avoidWhen.condition: Text only needs an italic visual treatment without stress emphasis.
Text needs importance rather than stress emphasis.
avoidWhen.useInstead: native strong inside the surrounding text owner

composition: Keep Em inside the Text, heading, link, or component content owner whose sentence it completes.

rules.statement: Use Em only for native stress emphasis and preserve its one em host; do not select it merely for italic paint.
Let Em inherit the surrounding typography and foreground rather than introducing a separate size, tone, or weight recipe.
Load styles.css or core.css plus em.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Em as a decorative italic label or replacing a sentence-level text owner with Em.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep Em inside meaningful surrounding copy and use it only when stress emphasis is semantically intended.

validation: Confirm one native em element, inherited metrics and foreground, readable forced colors, normal selection and copy, and no tab stop or role.
Check nested sentence flow, localization, zoom, RTL, and CSS delivery.
